The '''Conciliator''' was a position on the [[Royal Court]] of [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. The Conciliator's purpose was to voice the merits of a visitor's proposal and provide possible compromises to make the discussion more favorable to the [[Rajah]].
